Class Vehicle

java.lang.Object
common.vehicles.Vehicle
Direct Known Subclasses:
Car, Motorcycle
public abstract class Vehicle extends Object
Common superclass for rentable vehicles. Shared vehicle information is stored once here, while subclasses override calculateRentalCost(int) to provide their own prices.

    • calculateRentalCost

      public abstract double calculateRentalCost(int rentalDays)
      Calculates a rental charge for this vehicle type. Each concrete subclass supplies its own rate by overriding this method.
      Parameters:
      rentalDays - the positive rental duration
      Returns:
      the total rental cost
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the duration is not positive
